summary: Iteration 43 tested the requested add-ons, discount lifecycle/quote, blacklist enforcement, numeric Auto-Live target guidance, API-key rotation, Discord guild ownership CRUD, moderator role persistence, client UI, and Admin Discounts/Users UI against the public URL. Requested backend feature flows passed; overall backend suite passed 8/12 because owner-only discount APIs accept moderators and the three required auth-hardening checks still fail. All requested UI flows passed after adding the specified nav-discord test ID.

critical.issue: Owner-only discount-key APIs use check_admin() and are accessible to moderator/staff sessions. A promoted testbugfix1 moderator token received 200 from GET /admin/discount-keys instead of 403.
Successful login returns the JWT only in JSON and sets no Secure HttpOnly access cookie; Set-Cookie is absent for both documented accounts.
No brute-force lockout: six fresh-captcha wrong-password attempts returned [401, 401, 401, 401, 401, 401], with no 429 after the fifth failure.
Credentialed CORS allows an untrusted origin with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * instead of explicit trusted origins.
EUR add-ons are displayed as €180/€200 but purchase logic treats the numeric price as USD wallet units; blacklist_package returned 'needs $180.00'. Currency is relabeled, not converted.

minor.issue: Dashboard bootstrap repeatedly receives 502 for existing pending deposits because NOWPayments account email/password is not configured; backend reconciler logs show the same retries roughly every 90 seconds.

integration_issues.issue: Every login auto-posts verification for a pending NOWPayments transaction and silently gets 502; the client swallows the failure and retries on later ticks instead of gating auto-verify on configuration or surfacing status.
CurrencyContext fetch to https://api.frankfurter.dev/latest?base=USD&symbols=EUR returns 404, so users silently receive the hardcoded fallback rate.

action_items: Protect all discount-key admin routes with check_owner(), not check_admin().
Issue Secure HttpOnly auth cookies, add persistent five-failure login lockout, and restrict credentialed CORS to explicit frontend origins.
Define one wallet settlement currency and convert EUR add-on prices before balance comparison/debit; ensure API messages use the actual currency.
Make discount max-use redemption atomic so concurrent redemptions cannot exceed max_uses.
Disable/suspend NOWPayments polling when account lookup credentials are unavailable, and replace or correct the failing Frankfurter exchange-rate URL.
Retest the four failing pytest cases plus EUR purchase debit semantics after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_discount_keys_list/create/delete call check_admin(x_admin_token) without an owner check or permission, so any STAFF_SESSIONS token passes.
client_discount_redeem checks uses then increments in separate operations; concurrent requests can exceed max_uses. Use an atomic conditional update and only activate the user after it succeeds.
addons_purchase ignores addon.currency and compares/debits price directly against the USD transaction-derived wallet; frontend currency labeling alone does not implement EUR pricing.
auth_and_chat.login returns a plain dict without setting a response cookie, verify_login_credentials has no failure tracker, and server.py defaults credentialed CORS to '*'.

server.py (9,800 lines), Admin.jsx (7,725 lines), and ClientDashboard.jsx (5,175 lines) exceed the 700-line maintainability limit. Focused frontend lint still reports 42 ClientDashboard and 60 Admin errors/warnings; split feature modules and address swallowed API errors.

success_rate.backend: 67% overall (8/12); requested functional flows passed, owner authorization and auth security failed
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested UI flows passed; two unrelated dashboard background integrations returned errors

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned temporary backend/UI discount keys, qaprotected1 Instagram blacklist entry, and a unique Discord guild config. testbugfix1 role was restored to user and prior discount fields were restored. API key rotation intentionally persisted. No SMM/provider order was placed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only test_iteration_43_addons_discount_discord.py. Current JUnit is 8 pass / 4 fail: moderator access to owner-only discounts, missing HttpOnly cookie, wildcard CORS, and no five-failure lockout. Client UI passed Add-ons, nav-discord, Discord controls, Security/twofa-card, and invalid Discount toast. Admin secret URL passed Discounts generate/delete and Users moderator-option checks. The nav-discord test ID was added in scope. Investigate EUR wallet conversion separately because the current API explicitly quotes $180 for a catalog item labeled EUR.
rca_of_the_issue: Authorization fails because discount routes call the broad check_admin helper rather than check_owner. Auth hardening is absent in implementation/config: login returns JSON-only bearer auth, credential verification has no attempt counter, and CORS uses the wildcard environment default. EUR pricing is only presentation metadata; purchase arithmetic never reads currency. Dashboard integration errors come from unconditional pending-deposit verification without NOWPayments lookup credentials and an exchange-rate URL currently returning 404.
